literal_meaning: ডাক-ডাকানি এবং শোরগোলের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic representation of loud cries and noise)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় ডামাডোল করে সবাই চিৎকার করতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: Suddenly, there was a hubbub in the market.
Everyone started shouting, creating a clamor in the meeting.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to depict noisy disorder.
